facts.quote: LXE Hearing, the parent company of Eargo, Lexie Hearing, Go Hearing, and hearX, has announced it is winding down its US operations after failing to identify a viable path forward following restructuring efforts.
facts.text: LXE Hearing, the parent company of the Lexie brand, announced it is winding down its US operations after failing to find a viable path forward.

facts.quote: According to the company’s announcement, customer service representatives will remain available through at least Sept 15, 2026, and will be able to assist with troubleshooting, eligible refunds, and active warranty claims.
facts.text: Customer service will stay available for troubleshooting, eligible refunds and active warranty claims through at least September 15, 2026, and warranty plans beyond that date are still being developed.

facts.quote: The apps will eventually stop being available for new downloads, though the company hasn't set a removal date, and it isn't promising any further software or firmware updates.
facts.text: The Lexie app keeps working for now, but it will eventually stop being available for new downloads, with no removal date set and no promised further software or firmware updates.

facts.quote: Eargo customers can reach support at support@eargo.com or 1-855-690-9360; Lexie and Go Hearing customers can reach support at support@lexiehearing.com or 1-800-499-1336.
facts.text: Lexie and Go Hearing owners can contact support by email at support@lexiehearing.com or by phone at 1-800-499-1336.
